metadata.monte_carlo_scope: probabilities are per fixed cloud/condition; no family-wise coverage is claimed
metadata.radius_convention: maximum edge length divided by two
metadata.figure_error_bars: reparam: 1.96 Monte Carlo standard errors; event probabilities: Wilson 95%

dictionary.dictionary_class: regular constructions; counts are not optimal covering numbers

channel.block_crossing_estimator: adjacent sampled sigmas bracketing the first marginal partition-failure frequency reaching 0.10; this is a grid bracket, not a confidence interval for the population threshold or a first-event onset quantile
channel.sigma_grid_definition: union of 17 normalized levels 0.15..0.75, 41 normalized levels 0.25..0.45 (step 0.005), 16 absolute levels 0.30..0.45, and 0,0.25,sqrt(2)/4,0.5
channel.onset_estimator: first sampled sigma per fixed noise path; empirical inverse-CDF quantiles include right-censored replicates; null quantile means beyond sweep

event_definitions.zero_cross_contact: at least one debiased cross distance is zero
event_definitions.debiased_collapse: the entire graph is connected at radius zero
event_definitions.partition_failure: the theta graph does not recover both true labelled components
event_definitions.raw_spurious: raw H0 threshold count exceeds two

mismatch.sync_source: labelled separated local endpoint chart, births >= eps0; K/reference are shared

task.source_measure: uniform surface area on torus of revolution, major radius 2 and minor radius 1

pixels64.interpretation: finite-sample slab-component diagnostic, not a certified Reeb entropy

pca16.interpretation: finite-sample slab-component diagnostic, not a certified Reeb entropy

dataset.name: scikit-learn optical recognition of handwritten digits
dataset.representation: 64 raw pixels and 16-dimensional PCA fitted only to reference IDs
